data.name: Muhibb
data.gender_notes: Muhibb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'h-b-b', meaning 'to love' or 'to be fond of'. This name is a reminder of Allah's infinite love for His creation and the love that should exist between family and friends. In Islamic history, Muhibb is a title given to those who are deeply devoted to Allah and His Prophet. The name Muhibb carries the meaning “Lover, Affectionate, Devoted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhibb usually hope their child will grow to embody lover, affectionate, devoted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the love of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, as well as the love for the religion and its teachings.
data.etymology: Muhibb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover, Affectionate, Devoted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhibb total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
